versions.changelog: Publish clean 0.4.1 bundle with default auto local service mode, HTTP/FastAPI parser, stdlib IPC fallback, direct CLI fallback, uv-first installer, and one-command invoice demo.

Add app-like local service mode: auto-starting HTTP/FastAPI parser with stdlib IPC and direct CLI fallbacks, uv-first installer, one-command invoice demo scripts, and improved docs for user-defined invoice field extraction.
Fix SKILL.md frontmatter metadata so ClawHub can parse the MinerU/OpenVINO summary correctly; package contents remain the 0.2.0 MinerU runtime and custom-field extraction update.
Upgrade document parsing to MinerU 2.5 with OpenVINO GenAI, add lightweight local runtime setup, and support custom invoice key-field extraction via --fields.
Reduced published attack surface by shipping a CLI-first bundle and removing runtime compatibility shims from diagnostics.
Clearer quick start, better invoice demos, and diagram-to-notebook support

Harden the local UI file preview path handling, restrict UI file access to approved local folders, remove raw path preview URLs, and block custom interpreter/script override keys in the wrapper config.
Remove non-essential screen/demo helpers, stop auto-installing remote OCR wheel by default, and clarify safety guidance for dependencies, generated code, and artifact handling.
